name: crm-sales-management-system
description: CRM Sales Management System Fullstack App

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
